Vay Vandana Pension Yojana

Department of Social Justice and Empowerment

Pension

Monthly pension support for eligible senior citizens in Gujarat.

Eligibility

  • Applicants aged 60 years or above.
  • Annual income must not exceed Rs. 150,000.
  • Resident of Gujarat.
  • Available to both male and female applicants.

Benefits

Monthly pension assistance of Rs. 1,000.

Documents Required

  • Aadhaar card
  • Age proof
  • Income certificate
  • Gujarat residence proof
Apply online
